units.source_text: 在此之前，我一次也沒拜訪過堀木的家，通常都是我發電報叫堀木過來找我，

en.t: Until then, I had never once visited Horiki's home myself; usually I sent a telegram and had Horiki come to me,

units.source_text: 而現在我連電報費都交不起了，更何況落魄到這種地步，發個電報，堀木恐怕也不會來的。

en.t: but now I could not even afford the telegram fee, and fallen as low as this, even if I sent one, Horiki probably would not come.

units.source_text: 於是，我決定挑戰一下自己最不擅長的「拜訪」，

en.t: So I decided to attempt the thing I was worst at: paying a visit,

units.source_text: 嘆了口氣坐上了電車，對我來說，難道這個世界上唯一的救星就是堀木嗎？

en.t: I sighed and boarded the streetcar, wondering whether Horiki was truly the only savior left for me in this world.

units.source_text: 一想到這兒，一股穿透脊骨的淒涼寒意襲遍全身。

en.t: The moment I thought that, a desolate chill that seemed to pierce my spine swept through my whole body.

units.source_text: 他的家位於骯髒的小巷深處，是一棟兩層建築。

en.t: His home stood deep inside a filthy alley, a two-story building.

units.source_text: 堀木住在二樓僅有六張榻榻米大的房間。

en.t: Horiki lived upstairs in a room of only six tatami mats.
